fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects additions to the Emond Launch Daemon that adversaries may use to gain persistence and elevate privileges.
fields.name: MacOS Emond Launch Daemon
fields.query: event.category="file" and (endpoint.os="osx" and ((tgt.file.path contains "/etc/emond.d/rules/" and tgt.file.path contains ".plist") or tgt.file.path contains "/private/var/db/emondClients/"))
